name: Skunk Kush
summary: Skunk Kush is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]] from [[hindu-kush|Hindu Kush]] and [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]]. Sensi describes the Hindu Kush side as pure Afghan genetics. It is indica-leaning with a short flowering time both indoors and out, and the breeder gives no release year.

sources.title: 'Skunk Weed': A Beginner's Guide to Skunk
sources.note: Sensi lists this among the Skunk #1 hybrids it developed from genetics it received in the Netherlands in 1982.
